description: Monitor a SharePoint document library for new or modified files.

tenant_id_env_var.label: Tenant Id Env Var
tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var with Azure tenant ID. Required unless resource_key is set.

client_id_env_var.label: Client Id Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with Azure app client ID. Required unless resource_key is set.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with Azure app client secret. Required unless resource_key is set.

folder_path.label: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Optional subfolder path within the library

file_extension_filter.label: File Extension Filter
file_extension_filter.description: Filter by extension e.g. '.xlsx' (empty = all files)

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger when new/modified files are detected

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a SharePointResourceComponent. When set, polls run via that resource's own list_library_items(...) method instead of the inline tenant_id_env_var/client_id_env_var/client_secret_env_var above.

name: SharePoint Monitor
